patches.name: Disable device account notification sync
patches.description: Stops the notification SDK from requesting a token for every Google account on the device, which under MicroG shows an "Account ... requested by Google News" notification per account. Account-bound push notifications are no longer registered.

patches.name: Enable CustomTabs
patches.description: Opens articles in your default browser through Custom Tabs instead of the in-app WebView, so browser ad blockers and extensions apply.

patches.name: GmsCore support
patches.description: Renames the app and routes Google sign-in through MicroG (GmsCore) instead of Google Play Services, so the patched app installs next to the stock app.

options.description: Package name of the patched app. Keep the default to update an install patched with docbt/patched-up.
Certificate SHA-1 that MicroG reports for this app. Try the Google News certificate if sign-in fails on a fresh install.

patches.name: Ambient light
patches.description: Fills the black bars around the video with a soft glow of the picture's colours, like Ambient light for YouTube. Configurable in Settings > Video and audio > Ambient light.

options.description: Whether the ambient light is on before it is changed in the app.
Initial blur strength in percent (0-100).
Initial spread of the picture into the bars in percent (0-100).
Initial glow brightness in percent (30-200).
Initial glow saturation in percent (0-250).
Initial glow updates per second (5-60).

patches.name: Danmaku comments
patches.description: Flows regular comments, live chat, and chat replays over videos like NicoNico/bilibili, with native in-app settings, NG words, and no API key.

options.description: Danmaku text size in sp (12-48).
Danmaku opacity percentage (20-100).
Seconds for a comment to cross the player (3-20).
Percentage of player height available to comments (20-100).
Maximum comments retained in memory for the current video (20-500).
First-run limit for excluding long comments (20-300).

patches.name: Disable Bugsnag Telemetry
patches.description: Makes the Bugsnag SDK discard every error and session report.

patches.name: Disable General Telemetry
patches.description: Skips Pinterest's analytics, attribution, ads measurement and tracking startup tasks.

patches.name: Remove Promoted Pins
patches.description: Makes every pin report itself as not promoted and not an active ad, which disables Pinterest's ad handling for pins.

patches.name: Auto-translate Reddit content
patches.description: Automatically invokes Reddit's existing post and comment translation path.

options.description: Translate visible posts and comments without tapping the translate indicator.
BCP-47 language tag sent through Reddit's translation request header.

patches.name: Disable Infinite Upgrade Popup
patches.description: Disables the "Want unlimited access? Get Sankaku Infinite!" upsell popup that periodically appears while browsing the app.

patches.name: Disable OTA bundle updates
patches.description: Always runs the JavaScript bundle shipped in the APK and stops HotUpdater from checking for updates, so over-the-air bundles cannot undo the other patches.

patches.name: Auto claim mission rewards
patches.description: Claims completed My missions rewards and draws their lotteries in the background, without the reward popup or the lottery animation, and shows a short message with the result.

options.description: Also draw lottery rewards automatically. When off, only point rewards are claimed.
Open the missions page invisibly while the app is open (at most every 5 minutes), so rewards are claimed without opening the Points tab. A short message shows what was claimed.

patches.name: Open in external browser
patches.description: Opens the web pages that SmartNews shows in its in-app browser in another installed browser instead: as a Custom Tab (the browser's own in-app browser) or in the browser app.

options.description: Package name of the browser, or several separated by commas (the first installed one is used). "default" uses the default browser app set in Android settings, which is also used when none of the chosen browsers is installed (without a default, the first installed browser).
Show pages in the browser's in-app browser (Custom Tabs) on top of SmartNews. Turn off to open them in the browser app itself.
Also open articles that SmartNews shows in its SmartView reader, as their original page.

patches.name: SmartNews cleanup
patches.description: Disables SmartNews ad config, native layouts, and reader ad nodes via stable anchors.

patches.name: Disable pixiv ad SDKs
patches.description: Skips initialization of AppLovin MAX, Google Mobile Ads and Amazon APS to reduce ad-related network traffic.

patches.name: Hide pixiv ads
patches.description: Removes the overlay, list, detail and interstitial ads. Does not unlock Premium features.

patches.name: Account: Watch without signing in
patches.description: While signed out, opens Twitch's own signed-out mode instead of stopping at the login screen. Account actions still ask you to sign in, signed-in use is unchanged. On once you select it, with a switch in the settings.

patches.name: Ads: Block ad server requests
patches.description: Stops banner, feed and audio ad requests before they are sent, in both the native and React Native screens.

patches.name: Ads: Block client video ads
patches.description: Stops the pre-roll, mid-roll and VOD ads the app requests and plays itself. Switch it off any time in the settings.

patches.name: Ads: Cover unreplaced ads
patches.description: Covers and mutes stitched ads that could not be replaced, for example on subscriber-only streams.

patches.name: Ads: Disable picture-by-picture
patches.description: Stops the small picture-by-picture ad player from opening beside the stream.

patches.name: Ads: Replace stitched ads
patches.description: When Twitch stitches an ad into a live stream, swaps in an ad-free playlist of the same stream from Twitch. No third-party server unless you set a stream proxy.

patches.name: Auto claim channel points
patches.description: Claim available bonus chests automatically after Twitch's eligibility checks. Coalesces updates and bounds retries for each claim.

patches.name: Chat: Appearance
patches.description: Text size, time stamps, alternating rows and login names.

patches.name: Chat: Badges and pronouns
patches.description: Offers third-party badges, 7TV name paints and pronouns. Off until you turn them on in the settings; once on, chatters' IDs are looked up with those services.

patches.name: Chat: Compact chat
patches.description: Offers to leave badges out of chat lines and to show emotes as their text, so no emote images load. Off until you turn it on in the settings.

patches.name: Chat: Emote and badge info
patches.description: Offers a small sheet with the larger image, name and source when you tap a third-party emote or badge, and copies the name. Loads the image from the provider's CDN.

patches.name: Chat: Emote picker
patches.description: Adds a picker with favorites next to the message box, and suggestions after typing ':'.

patches.name: Chat: Filters
patches.description: Hides blocked words, hidden users and repeated messages on this device, and highlights phrases you choose.

patches.name: Chat: Hide highlights
patches.description: Offers to hide hype trains, pinned messages, gift banners, Bits and gift leaderboards, and watch-streak pop-ups above chat.

patches.name: Chat: Highlight first-time chatters
patches.description: Offers to tint a viewer's first message in a channel, using the first-msg tag from Twitch's chat server. Nothing leaves the device.

patches.name: Chat: History tools
patches.description: Recent chat from a public log, a search over messages you have seen, and a user lookup.

patches.name: Chat: Quick phrases
patches.description: Adds a row of phrases above the chat box that type into it when tapped; nothing is sent by itself. Off until you switch it on in the settings.

patches.name: Chat: Read chat aloud
patches.description: Reads live chat aloud with the device's text-to-speech. Off until you switch it on in the settings. Nothing leaves the device.

patches.name: Chat: Third-party emotes
patches.description: Shows 7TV, BetterTTV and FrankerFaceZ emotes in chat. Sends the ID of the channel you watch to those services to fetch its emotes.

patches.name: Chat: VOD support
patches.description: Applies the selected chat patches to VOD chat replay too.

patches.name: Danmaku chat
patches.description: Flows live chat, and the chat replay of VODs, over the video like NicoNico/bilibili, with emotes and NG words. Long-press the player menu button to switch it on or off.

patches.name: Drops: Auto-claim Drops
patches.description: Presses the Claim button of a channel's drops notification as soon as it shows a claimable drop. Sends the same claim request and event a tap sends, for your signed-in account. Off until you switch it on in the settings.

patches.name: Fix links during picture-in-picture
patches.description: Opens the stream or video of a link that arrives while another one plays in picture-in-picture. Twitch sometimes brought the old one back full screen instead.

patches.name: Fix login
patches.description: Optional workaround for the unsupported app/OS login error after re-signing. Skips Twitch's Play Integrity submission; leave off when login works.

patches.name: Fix login crash
patches.description: Stops sign-in from failing when Twitch's login page sends a field the app does not know.

patches.name: Fix notifications
patches.description: Repair push registration after re-signing. Adjusts the certificate and package name headers only for HTTPS Firebase Installations requests.

patches.name: Install: Separate app
patches.description: Installs the patched app next to the official Twitch app under its own package name instead of replacing it. Nothing extra leaves the device. Sign in again in the new app.

options.description: Package name of the patched app. It must differ from Twitch's.

patches.name: Interface: AMOLED black
patches.description: Turns the dark theme's greys black on screens drawn with Android views. Screens drawn with Compose and pop-up sheets keep their dark grey. Nothing leaves the device. Switch it on in the settings; applies after a restart.

patches.name: Interface: Disable update prompts
patches.description: Stops the in-app Play Store update prompts, which cannot install over a patched app. Switch it on in the settings.

patches.name: Interface: Following feed filters
patches.description: Chooses which sections appear in Following and how large stream cards are. On phones with Twitch 31.9.0 or later, the card size and the recommended streams need the classic home screen, switched on in the settings.

patches.name: Interface: Hide elements
patches.description: Offers to hide buttons and panels you do not use, such as leaderboards, Bits, clip, share and the unfollow heart.

patches.name: Interface: Hide recaps
patches.description: Offers to hide stream recaps (reels of a stream's clips) from the classic home feed and channel pages. On phones with Twitch 31.9.0 or later, the new home keeps its recap shelf unless the classic home screen is switched on in the settings.

patches.name: Interface: Hide upsells
patches.description: Hides subscription discount banners and Twitch's Turbo offers: the startup prompt, the after-signup prompt and the Home tab. The Subscribe button stays unless you hide it separately. Switch it on in the settings.

patches.name: Interface: Navigation bar position
patches.description: Moves the bottom navigation bar to the top of the screen, or hides it.

patches.name: Player: Background audio default
patches.description: Changes only the default of Twitch's background audio setting. A choice saved in Twitch's own settings still wins.

patches.name: Player: Chat speed graph
patches.description: Draws a small graph of chat speed over the player and notes sudden jumps. Nothing leaves the device. Off until you switch it on in the settings.

patches.name: Player: Close instead of mini player
patches.description: Offers to close the player with back instead of shrinking it to the floating mini player.

patches.name: Player: Default video quality
patches.description: Starts playback at a quality you choose, with a separate choice for metered networks. A quality you saved in the player still wins.

patches.name: Player: Force landscape on opening
patches.description: Turns the screen to landscape when a stream or video opens in the full player, and back when it closes. Home previews do not rotate. Switch it on in the settings.

patches.name: Player: Gestures
patches.description: Offers brightness and volume swipes along the edges of the player.

patches.name: Player: Landscape chat layout
patches.description: Changes the width and background of the chat beside the video in landscape.

patches.name: Player: Latency badge
patches.description: Shows how far a live stream is behind the broadcast on the theatre's player, green under 5 seconds, amber under 10 and red above. Tapping it reloads the stream through Twitch's own Retry. Nothing leaves the device beyond that reload. Switch it on in the settings.

patches.name: Player: Mini player size
patches.description: Makes the floating mini player larger or smaller.

patches.name: Player: No autoplay after videos
patches.description: Offers to keep Twitch from playing another video by itself when a VOD or clip ends.

patches.name: Player: Normal latency
patches.description: Turns off the player's low-latency mode, which adds a few seconds of delay but rebuffers less on a weak connection.

patches.name: Player: Official stats panel
patches.description: Shows Twitch's staff-only video stats panel in the player. Nothing leaves the device.

patches.name: Player: Playback speed
patches.description: Adds 0.25x to 2x playback. Faster than 1x on a live stream catches up, then returns to 1x.

patches.name: Player: Reload when stalled
patches.description: Reloads the stream the player menu's way when the on-screen player keeps buffering although the network is up, at most three times per stream. Off until you switch it on in the settings.

patches.name: Player: Reload, stats, mute and lock
patches.description: Adds a stream reload, a playback statistics panel, a mute and a touch lock to the player menu.

patches.name: Player: Remember settings per channel
patches.description: Remembers volume, danmaku, VOD speed and chat text size per channel once you ask it to from the player menu, and restores them when that channel opens. Stored only on this device.

patches.name: Player: Seek buttons
patches.description: Adds rewind and forward with your own step to the player menu for VODs.

patches.name: Player: Sleep timer
patches.description: Pauses playback after the time you choose, or stops when the video ends.

patches.name: Player: Stay on channel during raids
patches.description: Stops Twitch moving you to another channel when a raid happens and shows a pill to go there instead. Nothing leaves the device. Off until you switch it on in the settings.

patches.name: Player: Stream proxy
patches.description: Fetches live playlists through a proxy you choose. The proxy sees the channel you watch and your IP address.

patches.name: Player: VOD chapters
patches.description: Lists a VOD's chapters from Twitch's public data and jumps to them.

patches.name: Player: VOD chat offset
patches.description: Shifts VOD chat earlier or later when it does not match the video.

patches.name: Privacy: Clean share links
patches.description: Removes known tracking parameters from twitch.tv links you share or copy, keeping timestamps and other parameters. Nothing leaves the device. Switch it on in the settings.

patches.name: Privacy: Disable analytics
patches.description: Stops Twitch's usage events, Crashlytics, Sentry, Nielsen, Sprig and comScore, and Branch's custom events. Keeps the view-counting events that Drops and streamers' stats rely on, and Branch's start-up session. Switch it on in the settings.

patches.name: Privacy: Remove tracking permissions
patches.description: Removes the advertising ID and Play install-referrer permissions from the manifest, so Twitch and its SDKs cannot read those two identifiers. Google Play services keep working.

patches.name: Show deleted messages
patches.description: Keeps deleted or moderated chat messages readable instead of replacing them with "<message deleted>". The message turns into a tappable spoiler: tap it to reveal the original text. Only text already received by this client can be revealed.

patches.name: Startup: Default startup tab
patches.description: Chooses the screen Twitch opens on. Links and notifications still open what they point to.

patches.name: Startup: Fix stuck start screen
patches.description: Opens Twitch if its start screen is still waiting after 5 seconds, which can happen when Branch's link lookup never answers.

patches.name: Tools: Lifetime totals
patches.description: Shows how many ads this patch stopped, replaced and covered, channel point bonuses claimed and hours watched, at the top of the settings screen and on its About page. Stored only on this device.

release_notes:
### 対応バージョン

- 外した版：Reddit 2026.45.0（Morphe 公式のパッチ 2.3.0 で、公式の最新の対象が 2026.46.0 に変わったためです）

Reddit の対応版は 2026.40.0（公式のパッチの安定版の対象）と 2026.46.0（公式の最新の対象・ストアの最新版）です。
Reddit のパッチの中身は変えていません。2026.45.0 を使っている場合は、アプリを README の表の版に入れ替えてください。

### Twitch

**パッチを機能ごとに分けました。** `Block ads`・`Chat enhancements`・`Player enhancements` はなくなり、全 63 個から必要なものを選べます（[一覧](https://github.com/sabopura/sabopura-morphe-patches/blob/v1.19.0/docs/twitch.md#パッチ一覧)）。更新するときは、Morphe Manager でパッチを選び直してください。対応する Twitch の版は 1.18.3 と同じです。

### Twitch：設定画面とメニュー

- プレイヤーメニューと設定画面を作り直しました。ドラッグで動くシート、指に追従するスイッチとスライダー、スリープのダイヤル、動画の上の短い通知、メニューの並べ替えなどです。動きを減らす端末の設定に従います。
- 設定は使う場面ごとに 7 つに分けました（広告／チャット／弾幕／プレイヤー／ホームと表示／アカウントとプライバシー／このパッチについて）。最初の画面に、それぞれのオン・オフと、止めた広告などの累計が出ます。広い画面では、一覧と中身の 2 列になります。
- チャットと弾幕の設定に見本を付けました。文字サイズや時刻、速さなどを変えると、その場で見本が変わります。
- 設定の書き出しと読み込みを足しました（「このパッチについて」の「設定の引っ越し」）。別の鍵で署名した版や別アプリとして入れ直すと設定が空になるので、その前に書き出しておけます。
- 「このパッチについて」に、パッチ集と Twitch のバージョン、「診断」を足しました。Twitch の版が変わってパッチの一部が働かなくなったとき、その箇所を記録して、コピーや共有で不具合の報告に貼れます（アカウントの情報は含みません）。
- 設定・メニュー・通知の文は、日本語と英語があります。アプリ（またはスマホ）の言語に合わせて出ますが、「このパッチについて」の「表示言語」で、日本語か English に固定できます。
- 画面の読み上げ（TalkBack）とキーボードで操作できるようにしました。
- 起動直後のクラッシュが続いたときに、パッチの機能を自動で止める安全装置を入れました。パッチの処理が途中で失敗しても、Twitch を落とさずに本来の動きへ戻るようにしています。

### Twitch：広告

- 31.9.0 以降のホームから開いた配信で、広告の差し替えが働いていなかったのを直しました（広告のない再生リストに差し替えられず、黒い画面で隠すだけになっていました）。
- 予備の再生リストが 1 回取れなかっただけで広告に戻っていた、いちばん高い画質で見ていると差し替えられなかった、別のプレイヤーの広告で画面が黒くなった、といった不具合を直しました。

### Twitch：弾幕

- VOD でも弾幕が流れます。チャットのリプレイを再生位置に合わせて流すので、チャットを閉じた全画面でも流れ、一時停止・シーク・倍速にも合います（弾幕の設定の「VOD でも流す」）。
- 弾幕が配信の遅れに合わせて流れるようになりました。映像が大きく遅れているとき、遅れのうち約 3 秒を超える分だけコメントを待たせるので、まだ見ていない場面への反応が先に流れません。これまでどおりにするには、弾幕の設定の「配信の遅れに合わせる」をオフにします。
- プレイヤーの操作部が出ている間は弾幕を薄くして、ボタンや題名を読めるようにしました。
- NG ワードの正規表現のうち、文法が正しくない式や極端に時間がかかる式（`(a+)+` など）は使いません。使わなかった式は、設定の行に表示します。

### Twitch：チャット

- チャットの読み上げ、入力欄の上の定型文チップ、チャットの速さのグラフを足しました。読み上げの声は、発言の文字に合わせて日本語と英語を切り替えます（「声の言語」で、端末の言語・日本語・英語に固定もできます）。エモートの名前は読みません（「エモートの名前も読む」で読めます）。同じ文字の長い連続は短く読み、日本語の声では「www」を「わら」、「888」を「ぱちぱち」と読みます。
- 7TV の名前のペイントを表示できます（「エモートとバッジ」の「7TV の名前のペイントを表示」。初期値はオフ）。7TV の登録者が名前に付けているグラデーションや画像を、チャットの名前にそのまま描きます。
- 指定したユーザーの発言をハイライトできます（フィルターの「ハイライトするユーザー」）。ハイライト・初めての発言・交互の背景は、文字の後ろだけでなく行の幅いっぱいに付くようになりました。
- 追加エモートの選択画面を、画像のグリッド（お気に入り／チャンネル／グローバル、検索）に作り直しました。タップしても閉じないので続けて選べます。`:` の入力補完の候補にも画像が付きます。
- 過去チャット・履歴の検索・ユーザー検索を、プレイヤーメニューと同じ見た目のシートに作り直しました。Twitch のエモートも画像で出ます。
- 過去チャットで、空白のない本文のメッセージが抜け落ちていたのを直しました。日本語のチャットはほとんどが空白のない本文なので、流れの速い日本語の配信では 500 件のうち 10 件ほどしか出ていませんでした。
- 「送信時刻を表示」をオンにすると、バッジのある行では時刻が出ずに同じバッジが 2 つ並び、バッジのない行では時刻が名前の色になっていたのを直しました。
- そのほか：動くエモートが静止画になっていた、31.9.0 で VOD のチャットに追加エモートなどが出なかった、ログイン名で非表示にした人が弾幕と読み上げには出ていた、文字サイズを変えているとエモートとバッジの大きさが途中で変わった、のを直しました。

### Twitch：プレイヤー

- 読み込みが止まったときの自動の再読み込み、レイドで勝手に移動しない、チャンネルごとの設定の記憶を足しました。
- 動画が終わったあと、次の動画が勝手に始まらないようにできます（`Player: No autoplay after videos`。設定の「動画が終わったら次を自動再生しない」）。スリープタイマーには、VOD で選べる「この動画が終わったら」を足しました。
- プレイヤーメニューに「消音」と「画面ロック」を足しました。消音は、端末の音量を変えずに見ている配信や動画の音だけを消します。画面ロックは、タッチと戻る操作を受け付けなくします（左上の鍵のボタンを長押しで解除）。
- 戻る操作で、ミニプレイヤーにせずプレイヤーを閉じられます（`Player: Close instead of mini player`。「プレイヤー › レイアウト」の「戻るでプレイヤーを閉じる（ミニプレイヤーにしない）」）。
- VOD のプレイヤーにも、パッチのメニューボタンが出るようになりました（これまではどの版でも出ていませんでした）。縦型のクリップ用プレイヤーには出ません。
- 31.9.0 以降の VOD で、チャプターとチャット同期が出ない、覚えた速度が当たらない、チャンネルの追加エモートが出ない、という状態だったのを直しました。
- 一時停止から戻るたびに覚えた VOD の速度と音量に戻されていた、「キャストボタンを隠す」が VOD のプレイヤーで効いていなかった、のを直しました。
- 小窓（ピクチャーインピクチャー）で見ている間に配信のリンクを開くと、小窓の動画が全画面に戻るだけで、開いた配信に切り替わらないことがあったのを直しました（`Fix links during picture-in-picture`。VOD を小窓にしているとき、約半分の割合で起きていました）。

### Twitch：ホームと表示

- 31.9.0 以降のスマホではホームが新しい作りになり、フォロー中の欄の設定が効かなくなっていました。「フォロー中のカテゴリを隠す」「視聴の続きを隠す」「オフラインのチャンネルを隠す」と、「表示の整理」の「広告なしプランの案内を隠す」（フォロー中のタブのボタン）は、新しいホームのままで効くようにしました。見出しも空白も残りません。
- 「配信を大きなカードで表示」と「おすすめ配信を隠す」は、新しいホームでは効きません。そのために「従来のホーム画面を使う」（初期値はオフ）を足しました。オンにすると、Twitch がタブレットなどで使っている従来のホームに切り替わり、この 2 つも効きます。
- 配信のリキャップ（配信のクリップをまとめた棚）を隠せます（`Interface: Hide recaps`。「表示の整理」の「配信のリキャップを隠す」）。チャンネルのページと従来のホームで効きます。新しいホームの棚は隠せません。
- 「探索タブを隠す」は、実際のタブの名前に合わせて「ブラウズタブを隠す」に直しました（設定はそのまま引き継がれます）。

### Twitch：そのほか

- 他のパッチ集から良い部分を取り込みました：既定の画質、起動時のタブ、起動画面の固まり解消、解析の停止、共有リンクの掃除、更新案内の停止、Drops の自動受け取り、AMOLED 黒、エモートのタップ表示、コンパクトチャット、ログインせずに見る、など。出典は [NOTICE](https://github.com/sabopura/sabopura-morphe-patches/blob/v1.19.0/NOTICE) にあります。
- ポイントのボーナスの自動受け取りを、設定のスイッチで止められるようにしました（パッチを当て直す必要はありません）。累計の「受け取ったボーナス」は、成功した回数だけ数えるようにしました。
- 別アプリとして入れたとき（`Install: Separate app`）に、横向きの強制・表示の整理・エモートのボタン・遅延バッジが効かなかったのを直しました。
- 「フォロー解除ボタンを隠す」が 30.7.2 で効かない恐れがあったのを直しました。
- 設定の値の形式が食い違っているとき（手で書き換えた設定を読み込んだ場合など）に、配信を開くと Twitch が落ちることがあったのを直しました。
